scope: Seventeen retained cell-process source clauses. This is a refinement/follow-up, not 17 new curriculum-denominator points.

evidence.passage: A completed macroautophagosome has separate inner and outer membranes, with space between them.

remaining: A visible gap width is a drawing convention, not a measured dimension.

evidence.passage: When it fuses with a lysosome, the outer membrane joins the lysosomal boundary, while the inner membrane is degraded before enzymes gain access to the enclosed cargo.

remaining: The hourglass contour and colour join are schematic; no empirical contour shape is asserted.

evidence.passage: Tsuboyama and colleagues found that loss of ATG conjugation systems markedly delayed inner-membrane degradation even when fusion occurred.

Product return has evidence in defined systems. In leucine-starved cultured human HEK-293T cells, Wyant and colleagues found that SLC38A9 was needed for leucine made by lysosomal protein breakdown to reach the cytosol; the response also depended on the autophagy protein ATG7. Abu-Remaileh and colleagues measured regulated lysosomal amino-acid exchange in mammalian cells. Yeast experiments identified Atg22, Avt3 and Avt4 as partially redundant vacuolar amino-acid exporters. These results support amino-acid recycling in those systems, without establishing transport of every breakdown product, secretion from the cell or guaranteed growth.

remaining: These studies do not establish all non-amino-acid products or export from individually identified autolysosomes. Intact transport rather than rupture is an interpretation of transporter experiments.

evidence.passage: A direct-fusion sketch omits intermediate endosomal interactions described in multicellular organisms; it is not the complete route taken by every compartment.

remaining: The Guide caption owner may explicitly add that colours are conventions. Shape and size are already called schematic; this does not require invented literature proof.

evidence.passage: Preparing a double-strand break for homologous repair includes DNA end resection in the 5′ to 3′ direction, leaving protruding 3′ single-stranded ends.
RAD51 helps a prepared strand find and pair with a complementary strand in matching duplex DNA, displacing the other template strand into a D-loop.

remaining: The exact word antiparallel is not quoted from the selected passages. The record uses complementary pairing; the Guide orientation is an interpretation of the stated DNA topology, not an independent human RAD51 structural measurement.

evidence.passage: Synthesis-dependent strand annealing can finish as a noncrossover repair: the extended strand leaves the template and pairs with the other broken end. Other homologous-repair routes can have crossover outcomes, so using an intact template does not mean every repair leaves donor and recipient arrangements unchanged.

remaining: Template stays in the Guide is already scoped to one successful illustrative route, so it is not rejected as a universal claim.

evidence.passage: The matrix-facing F1 part uses the transferred energy to make ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. Protons provide the driving force; they are not converted into ATP.
Protons return from the intermembrane space to the matrix through the membrane-embedded Fo part of ATP synthase.
A parallel proton leak bypasses ATP synthase and dissipates the gradient.
E1 enzymes activate ubiquitin, E2 enzymes carry it and E3 ligases help select substrates and assemble modifications.

remaining: This confirms the general selection statement at abstract scope, not a literal substrate-Q experiment in the drawing.

evidence.passage: PERK phosphorylates eIF2alpha and can reduce translation initiation.
Other kinases can phosphorylate eIF2alpha, so one phosphosite cannot identify the whole response.

For 100 mutations, a 50/50 mixture gives 35, 35, 20, 10; a 60/40 mixture gives 36, 34, 20, 10. The close reconstructions illustrate ambiguity; these are arithmetic examples, not fitted SBS3 data or observed biological results.

remaining: Arithmetic is independently reproduced; the prior method interpretation is retained at its recorded depth.

evidence.passage: Loss of heterozygosity means losing one parental version, with or without a reduction in total copy number.

remaining: A/B, A/absent and A/A are figure notation; no new figure view is claimed for genomic scars.
